# Gustavo Sanchez — Full Portfolio Context

Canonical website: https://www.gustavosanchez.dev/

## Professional summary

Gustavo Sanchez is a full-stack software engineer based in San Francisco. He is originally from Colombia and trained as an electronic and telecommunications engineer. His work combines systems engineering, software development, business-to-business sales experience, and applied artificial intelligence.

Gustavo focuses on engineering judgment: understanding why and when to build, planning execution, orchestrating AI coding agents, and making architecture and integration decisions from a solid technical foundation. He uses a spec-driven workflow that moves from constitution to specification, plan, tasks, implementation, and verification.

He builds modern web experiences with clean code, thoughtful architecture, accessible interfaces, and production-minded integrations. Recent projects emphasize privacy-conscious AI, open models, speech processing, full-stack product development, testing, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.

### Quality and delivery

## Featured projects

### EnglishChunks.guru — Daily English Speaking Coach

Website: https://englishchunks.guru

Repository: https://github.com/gusanchefullstack/englishchunks.guru

A 12-minute daily speaking coach for English learners, built around ready-made language chunks. Learners hear examples, record themselves, receive pronunciation scoring and targeted feedback, write sentences that are polished by AI, and read their work aloud. The production system uses self-hosted open speech models so recordings do not reach a third-party AI API and are deleted after scoring. It includes streaks, progress charts, an administration moderation queue, Stripe plans, and WCAG 2.2 AA checks. Built spec-first with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Gemma, speech models, ElevenLabs, Stripe, and Playwright.

### IdiomsMasterGirl — Daily Idiom Practice

Repository: https://github.com/gusanchefullstack/idioms-master-girl

A local-first English practice partner that teaches one idiom per day through listening, speaking, writing, and read-aloud exercises. Gemma runs through Ollama as the tutor, while faster-whisper performs local speech recognition with per-word confidence. The open core runs on the user's laptop so recordings remain local. Built spec-first with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, SQLite, Gemma, Ollama, faster-whisper, ElevenLabs, and Vitest.

### Nelson — Personal Budget App

Website: https://fsdev-nelson-frontend.vercel.app

Repository: https://github.com/gusanchefullstack/fsdev-nelson-frontend

A full-stack personal budgeting application that tracks expected payments in separate buckets. It includes guided and complete budget creation, forecast-versus-actual reporting, projections, insights, threshold alerts, authentication, responsive themes, and WCAG 2.2 AA audits. Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, TanStack Router, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Better Auth, Zod, Vitest, and Playwright.

### FX Checker

Website: https://fsdev-foreign-exchange-checker.vercel.app

Repository: https://github.com/gusanchefullstack/fsdev-foreign-exchange-checker

A currency converter and market research interface with live central-bank rates, searchable currencies, a market ticker, historical charts, multi-currency comparison, favorites, conversion history, shareable URLs, keyboard shortcuts, CSV export, and offline fallback. It earned a 100 Lighthouse accessibility score and includes extensive automated tests.
